title: The cohomology pullback is induced by the unit of the derived adjunction
statement:
Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $u_*$ be the direct image and $Ru_*:\Dplus(Y_{\Et})\to\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, $Ru_*L=u_*J$ for a K-injective resolution $L\to J$, its derived functor [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], let $u^{-1}:\Dplus(X_{\Et})\to\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ be the inverse image on bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and let $\eta^D_u:\mathrm{id}\to Ru_*u^{-1}$ be the unit of the derived adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction]. Write $\RGamma(T_{\Et},-)$ and $H^q(T_{\Et},-)$ for the derived global sections and the cohomology groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Then:

1. (Leray identification.) For every bounded below K-injective complex $J$ of abelian sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$, the complex $u_*J$ on $X_{\Et}$ is K-injective; hence for $L\in\Dplus(Y_{\Et})$ with K-injective resolution $L\to J$ the equality of complexes $\Gamma(X,u_*J)=\Gamma(Y,J)$ (as $(u_*J^r)(X)=J^r(X\times_XY)=J^r(Y)$) is an isomorphism $\lambda_L:\RGamma(X_{\Et},Ru_*L)\xrightarrow{\sim}\RGamma(Y_{\Et},L)$ in $\Dplus(\Ab)$, natural in $L$.
2. (Alternative description of $u^*$.) For every $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$, in particular for an abelian sheaf $G$ on $X_{\Et}$ placed in degree $0$, the pullback $u^*:\RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\to\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K)$ of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] equals the composite

$$
 \RGamma(X_{\Et},K)\xrightarrow{\ \RGamma(X,\eta^D_{u,K})\ }\RGamma(X_{\Et},Ru_*u^{-1}K)\xrightarrow{\ \lambda_{u^{-1}K}\ }\RGamma(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}K),
$$

and so $u^*:H^q(X_{\Et},G)\to H^q(Y_{\Et},u^{-1}G)$ is $\mathcal H^q$ of this composite for every $q\ge0$. Here $\RGamma(T_{\Et},-)$ acts on morphisms as the derived functor of the additive left exact functor $\Gamma(T,-)$ on $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated] (for $a:K\to K'$, $\RGamma(T,a)$ is the class of $\Gamma(T,\tilde a)$, $\tilde a$ the unique homotopy class of maps of the chosen K-injective resolutions lifting $a$), and a complex $\Gamma(T,I)$ computed from any K-injective complex $I$ with an isomorphism $QI\cong K$ is identified with $\RGamma(T_{\Et},K)$ by the canonical isomorphism $Q\Gamma(T,h)$, $h$ the comparison homotopy equivalence of resolutions; the equalities of clauses 1 and 2 are meant after these identifications, which are the ones of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] and [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial] (1).

proof.text: For lowerStar_isKInjective_boundedBelow apply Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes to the exact inverse-image/direct-image adjunction. The bounded below mapping functor has the same underlying mapped complex, so the preservation theorem applies directly. Exactness is supplied by the already proved library instances, without using the separate statement upperStar_abelian_exact.

For lerayPlus_on_kInjective first prove a private general lemma: choose a bounded below complex of injective objects representing Qh K using the proved equivalence K+(Inj) ≌ D+. Since both it and K are K-injective, bijectivity of Qh on maps into each lifts the two arrows of the derived isomorphism; injectivity of Qh proves the inverse identities. Naturality transports invertibility of the derived unit from the complex of injective objects to K. Direct image of J is K-injective by the preceding argument. Apply the general lemma to direct image, global sections on its image, and global sections on J.

For derivedCohomologyPullback_eq_derivedUnit form the natural transformation Γ of the derived adjunction unit followed by the canonical Leray composition isomorphism. By rightDerived_ext its equality with rightDerivedDesc reduces to compatibility after precomposing with the Γ derived unit on every bounded below homotopy object M. Expand the derived adjunction unit using derivedPlus_unit_app_fac, move the inverse inverse-image factorization through the Leray map by naturality, and move the localized underived unit through the Γ derived unit. The composite remaining on the right is rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompUnit followed by the Leray map; rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompIso'_fac identifies it with the mapped sectionwise isomorphism followed by the Γ derived unit on L(M). Cancel the common tails by congruence and compare through the faithful inclusion of the bounded below homotopy category. Present M as the quotient of a complex; mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient and mapHomotopyCategory_map reduce to the definitionally equal maps of complexes. Thus the two natural transformations agree, and their components at K agree.

split_report.summary: Split into 8 steps following Stacks cohomology.tex 01F8/01F9/01FA/01EZ, sites-cohomology.tex 08J6 and derived.tex 08BJ; no new node. Statement made precise by one added sentence: RGamma(T,-) on morphisms is the derived functor of Gamma(T,-) in the sense of lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated (def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology defines RGamma on objects only, but the statement applies it to eta^D), and complexes Gamma(T,I) from other K-injective representatives are identified with RGamma by the canonical comparison isomorphisms, which are those of def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback and lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-functorial (1); these two nodes were added to stmt_deps. Steps: (1) conventions, Gamma and u_* additive left exact, Rv on objects and morphisms; (2) Rv computed on any K-injective representative, Rv(a) tau = tau' Q(v f) (written out from lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived); (3) u_*J K-injective by the closed lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective (Stacks 08BJ) for every K-injective J, bounded below or not; (4) lambda_L from the equality Gamma(X,u_*J)=Gamma(Y,J), independent of J; (5) naturality in L; (6) representative of eta^D by property (2) of the closed prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction with M = K^bullet (not I^bullet, which need not be bounded below) and naturality of eta_u: f = u_*(r) o eta_{u,I}; (7) comparison, Gamma(X,f) is literally a -> r(eta_u(a)); (8) H^q. Leaves among the uses: lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves (Mathlib), lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective, lem-weil-pbc-derived-direct-image-triangulated, prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction, def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image (Lean closed).
